question: Sama Chakeva is a folk dance based on the mythological story of the siblings Sama and Chakeva, in which the brother goes to an extreme extent to save his sister. With which State of India is this folk dance associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sama Chakeva** is a traditional folk dance associated with the state of **Bihar**.
 
• This dance is performed during the **Kartik month** of the Hindu calendar, specifically in the Mithila region.
 
• The dance depicts the **mythological story** of the siblings Sama and Chakeva, highlighting the bond between brother and sister.
 
• **Mithila region**, where the dance is most popular, covers parts of Bihar and Nepal.
 
• The dance is performed by women, and it involves singing folk songs and creating clay idols representing the characters of the story.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mithila Painting:** Also known as Madhubani painting, this is a famous art form from the Mithila region of Bihar, characterized by complex geometrical patterns.
 
• **Chhath Puja:** A significant festival in Bihar, dedicated to the Sun God, celebrated with much fervor and involves rigorous rituals.
 
• **Bhojpuri Language:** Widely spoken in Bihar, Bhojpuri is a part of the Bihari languages group and has a rich tradition of folk songs and literature.
 
• **Jat-Jatin Dance:** Another popular folk dance of Bihar, depicting the life of a married couple and their day-to-day struggles.
 
• **Folk Music:** Bihar has a rich tradition of folk music, including genres like Birha, Kajari, and Sohar, often associated with various life events and seasons.
